name: Unsleeping Lamp (Bất Miên Đăng)
effects: The Lamp That Is Not Out
lore: A bronze storm lamp with a wick of twisted pearl-diver's line, lit by Ôn Thủ Đăng in the winter of 913 and never let go out since. He carries it from tower to tower. The hall believes it was the founder's; it was not. He made it the night Kim Sa Trấn drowned (V171).
build_use: The head's ward lamp: longer seals, one relit, and a steady soul.

name: Breakwater Seal (Phá Lãng Ấn)
lore: A square seal of black basalt from the Thạch Cơ shore, cut by Chân Định Lan for the storm wards she wants the hall to build instead of watching for sails. She used it on the palace's jetty at Thạch Cơ Thành in 1190, alone and at night, and the jetty cracked anyway (A312).
build_use: The storm elder's seal: stronger seals and wards.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Seal of the Kim Sa Lamp (Kim Sa Ấn)
lore: The keeper's seal of the Kim Sa tower, which drowned with the town in 913 (V171). Divers brought it up in 920. Every ward seal he has laid since has its mark.
build_use: A line of ward seals that do not go out.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Robe of the Pearl Divers (Châu Lệ Bào)
lore: A dark-blue robe of the Âu Lộ Thôn kind, with pearl-diver's line for its seams. His sworn brother had one like it.
build_use: Holds a line through a whole night: soul defence and linh lực.
made_by: the weavers of Âu Lộ Thôn
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Sea-Wall Shield (Hải Đê Thuẫn)
lore: A slab of Thạch Cơ basalt faced with the breakwater's lattice. She made it to show the hall what a sea wall would look like, and nobody looked.
build_use: Walls: block, guard and a body shield.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Jetty Stone (Thạch Cơ Ngọc Bội)
lore: A shard of the palace's jetty at Thạch Cơ Thành, from the crack the storm of 1190 opened through her wards (A312). She wears it so as not to forget.
build_use: A body that stands in surf.
